title: Rural Veterinary Workforce Act
latestAction: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.
summary:
Rural Veterinary Workforce Act 

This bill excludes from gross income, for federal tax purposes, payments received pursuant to the Veterinary Medicine Loan Repayment Program or any state loan repayment or loan forgiveness program that is intended to provide for increased access to veterinary services. (The Veterinary Medicine Loan Repayment Program is a Department of Agriculture program that repays a portion of the student loans of veterinarians who provide short-term services in designated veterinary shortage areas.)

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.
